messages:
jordan: Quick sync — QBR is next Wed. Need a single consolidated pack: partner tier scorecards, MDF reconciliation, hardware credit offsets, and SI launch + go‑to‑market timeline. Can we get a consolidated ask by EOD Friday? cc @elaine @omar

elaine: I can own the MDF reconciliation. Will pull last quarter spend vs commitments and flag gaps by Thursday. Posting the draft sheet in #docs later today. :memo:

ben: On marketplace credits/hardware offsets — talking to HW partner ops. They confirmed a 40 GPU credit pool we can allocate. Need to map which partners get priority (SI launches > marketplace promos).

sasha: SI launch update — SystemsInc still needs our cert bits and the connector smoke tests pass fail intermittently. Targeting a soft launch two weeks after cert signoff. I'll ping infra to prioritize the smoke test runs.

omar: Who's presenting the partner tier changes in the QBR? Also we should show a before/after impact on ARR and expected uplift, even if rough.

alice: I can take the tier slide + ARR impact if someone gives me the final scorecard numbers by Friday morning. Suggest 1 slide: current tier mix, proposed changes, estimated ARR delta.

jules: Suggest we add a short risk slide: MDF underspend, HW credit exhaustion, SI cert lag. Each with owner + mitigation. Quick example table below — feel free to paste into slides: 

```
Risk | Owner | Trigger | Mitigation
MDF shortfall | elaine | >$25k gap | reallocate reserve / request one-off top-up
HW credits exhausted | ben | credit balance < 10 GPUs | prioritize SI launches, pause promos
SI cert delay | sasha | cert not signed 3 days before QBR | escalate to infra lead, offer extra test window
```

jordan: Nice. Elaine — can you include the reconciled delta and list of recommended top-ups (if any)? Ben — can you propose an allocation priority for the 40 GPU credit pool? Sasha — timeline for cert + earliest possible soft launch date?

elaine: Will do. Quick note — I found two legacy MDF commitments that weren't in the ledger (around $8.5k combined). Adding to the draft.

ben: Proposed allocation (high level): 60% to SI launch buckets (SystemsInc, AlphaSI), 30% to joint marketplace promos, 10% reserve for spikes. I'll post a simple allocation sheet by EOD.

sasha: If infra can run the failing smoke test tomorrow we might salvage next-week cert. I'll cc infra in the doc. Worst case: push soft launch +1 week; still OK for QBR narrative.

omar: For the QBR narrative, let's be explicit: 1) Tier reshuffle to reward high-usage SIs, 2) one-time MDF top-up ask if gap > $20k, 3) HW credit policy for next quarter. Keep slides to 6 mins total.

alice: FYI — marketing wants at least one joint announcement stub for SystemsInc if the soft launch date holds. They'll draft co-branded blurb once we confirm timeline.

jordan: Action items: 
- elaine: final MDF recon + recommended top-ups (EOD Thu)
- ben: GPU credit allocation sheet (EOD Thu)
- sasha: cert status + earliest soft launch (EOD Thu)
- alice: tier slide template + ARR estimate (Fri AM)
- jules: risk slide + owners (Fri AM)

jordan: I'll collate everything and assemble the QBR section. Posting a link to the working deck here when ready: https://redwood.app/drive/partners/qbr-2026-draft

ben: ack :thumbsup:

elaine: ack — will flag any requests for budget approval in the doc.

sasha: ack, moving smoke tests up.

jordan: Thanks all — if anyone can't hit their EOD, shout now so we can reshuffle.
